title: Binary search
prompt: Implement `static int BinarySearch(int[] sorted, int target)` — return the index of `target` in the ascending array, or -1. Keep the invariant: if the target exists, it stays within [lo, hi].

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Both boundaries and an absent value — window edges are where bugs live.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: A one-element window (lo == hi) must still be examined.
